instrumentation: Appends a read-only reference to existing sessions module objects; no API/function behavior replacement. Inputs use fill/Tab, checkbox, mouse, or trusted browser touch contacts.

definitions.name: Ultrasonic-I2C

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: Write command byte 0x01 to 0x57, wait 120 ms in the official driver, then read three bytes as a big-endian 24-bit distance value. Driver divides the raw value by 1000 for millimeters and optionally by a further 10 for centimeters.

registers.encoding: BE uint24, 1000 raw units per mm

claims: guest driver transaction path and encoding

runtime.blocker: Controller model is compiled; same-guest and Web validation are pending

definitions.blocker: The official contract is documented, but no external Unit controller model, board routing and device-local runtime evidence is validated by this research artifact.
limitations: The source visual catalog officialDocs URL returned HTTP 404; the canonical product page above was successfully retrieved.
All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
definitions.input_semantics: External world/fixture state, to be delivered through a controller-level device model; not direct guest API return values.
definitions.output_semantics: Observed guest-to-Unit output; read-only to clients.
